2. POSITIVE catalyst (Anthropic $30B) suggests pullback is opportunity, not warning

The accumulating pullback (3.17% intraday, ~5.3% from yesterday's open) is approaching meaningful levels. - Yesterday = discipline to NOT trade despite 2.29% drop
